Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id is null) then
 show_error ('1307');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
--
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equipment_event ee
 where ee.equip_reference in 
 (select e.equip_reference from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1359');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then 
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_reference');
 begin
 select e.equip_reference
 into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 begin
 select e.equip_reference
 into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and sysdate between e.first_production_date and
 nvl (e.last_production_date, sysdate+1)
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference := null;
 list_values;
 end;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select code_desc 
 into :s_downtime_desc 
 from equip_master_codes 
 where code=:downtime_code 
 and code_type='DOWN';
 exception 
 when others 
 then null;
 end;
 
 begin
 select code_desc 
 into :s_service_desc 
 from equip_master_codes 
 where code=:service_code 
 and code_type='SRV';
 exception 
 when others 
 then null;
 end;
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 05/01/2012. IM 8545
 :equip_event.s_downtime_start := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :equip_event.downtime_start);
 :equip_event.s_downtime_end := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :equip_event.downtime_end);
 :equip_event.s_service_start := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :equip_event.service_start);
 :equip_event.s_service_end := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :equip_event.service_end);
 -- End of change
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_EVENT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
--
-- must be either a downtime or service event scheduled
--
 if (:service_code is null and :downtime_code is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('downtime_code');
 show_error ('1358');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- validate downtime record
--
 if ((:equip_event.downtime_code is not null) or (:equip_event.downtime_start is not null)) then
 if (:equip_event.downtime_code is null) then
 go_item ('downtime_code');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_event.downtime_start is null) then
 go_item ('downtime_start');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if ((:equip_event.downtime_flag = 'Y') and (:equip_event.downtime_end is null)) then
 go_item ('downtime_end');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
--
-- validate service record
--
 if ((:equip_event.service_code is not null) or (:equip_event.service_start is not null) or
 (:equip_event.service_person is not null) or (:equip_event.service_company is not null)) then
 if (:equip_event.service_code is null) then
 go_item ('service_code');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equip_event.service_start is null) then
 go_item ('service_start');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if ((:equip_event.downtime_flag = 'Y') and (:equip_event.service_end is null)) then
 go_item ('downtime_end');
 show_error ('0010');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if ((:equip_event.service_person is null) and (:equip_event.service_company is null)) then
 go_item ('service_person');
 show_error ('1361');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_I_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select e1.equip_id, substr(decode(least(nvl(e1.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, 'Not yet in Service', 'Service from :'||to_char(e1.first_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY')||' to: '||nvl(to_char(e1.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'PRESENT')),1,38) from equipment e1 where e1.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type and e1.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id and e1.equip_id in (select e2.equip_id from equipment e2 where e2.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type and e2.equip_reference in (select distinct (ee.equip_reference) from equipment_event ee))

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_T_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select emc.code, substr(emc.code_desc,1,20) code_desc from equip_master_codes emc where emc.code_type = 'EQUIP' and sysdate between emc.eff_date and nvl(emc.term_date, sysdate+1) and exists (select 'x' from fcn_grp_priv f, equip_access_privs eap where f.appl_id = 'DON' and f.user_id = upper(:banner.user_id) and eap.fcn_grp = f.grp_id and eap.equip_type = emc.code and sysdate between eap.eff_date and nvl(eap.term_date, sysdate+1)) and exists (select 'x' from equipment_event ee where ee.equip_reference in (select e.equip_reference from equipment e where e.equip_type = emc.code))
